title: 3316. Find Maximum Removals From Source String

examples.explanation: We can't remove source[0] but we can do either of these two operations: Remove source[1], so that source becomes "a_baa". Remove source[2], so that source becomes "ab_aa".
We can remove source[0] and source[3] in two operations.
We can't remove any character from source.
We can remove source[2] and source[3] in two operations.
